Several line numbers are off by a few lines (the flag file, CodeDevicesSection). No outright wrong claim was found. Gaps: the lost and logoutAll unlink options, heartbeat remote_enabled one-way behaviour, and the companion/dispatch gating mismatch.

checked.claim: Account/Local mode: Desktop and CLI permissions are local and need no subscription

missing_important_fact: Remote Control pairing is gated by a paid plan, a workspace policy gate and a kill switch. Mobile also checks the plan client-side via canUseBillingPlanCapability(tier,'remote_control'). Free users get 403 plan_upgrade_required. The page says the plans are unknown. See apps/web/lib/feature-flags/remote-control-gate.ts:62-125 and packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:352.

The page leaves out that computer.use, host.remote, shell.execute, application.control, browser.cdp and git.destructive are all high-risk (packages/contracts/local-runtime/src/capabilities.ts:67-74). So computer-control prompts never offer 'Always allow' and last only until the app quits. This resolves the page's own Unknown item about computer.use.

The CLI refuses a shell tool in an untrusted workspace unless the user approves that one command, and no auto-approval mode waives it. Workspace-layer 'Allow' policies are downgraded to 'Ask' until the repo is trusted (apps/cli/src/features/exec/tools/mod.rs:1784-1815). The page only mentions 'untrusted shell refusal' in passing.
review.overall: The page is mostly accurate on the desktop and CLI mechanics. Its weakest area is subscription. It says the plans for Remote Control are unknown and implies a simple on/off switch, but the code requires a paid plan (PAID_TIERS), a workspace policy gate and a kill switch. Free users get 403 plan_upgrade_required, and the desktop UI already says so. One citation is off: the mobile 'accounts are not compared' copy is at ConnectionStateViews.tsx:138, not :122. The page also leaves 'whether computer.use is high-impact' as unknown, but the code lists it as high-risk.

Subscription gating leaves out the managed-compute subscription check and canUseVoice, and it misses that Free has allowVoice with a 10 minute monthly cap. The sign-in claim for web cites a mobile-only file. 'Managed OpenAI only' overstates the provider rule, because the web gate requires a managed provider route for the chat, not OpenAI. The section 6 row on typed submit omits that the state moves to streaming only from certain statuses.

GET share returns an empty member list and null workspace name when the owner is no longer an active workspace member, so an owner who has left the workspace cannot pick people (apps/web/app/api/custom-agents/[id]/share/route.ts:40-44). The page does not mention it.

checked.claim: Limits: lookups use the 'default' rate limit and opens use 'chat-conversation' per user (route.ts:38-41,60-62)
checked.what_the_code_shows: handleRead uses withRateLimit(request,'default'). handleOpen uses 'chat-conversation' with key user:${userId}. The cloud open and status routes also use 'chat-conversation' per user.

checked.claim: Subscription: none found in the code for the local pull request route
checked.what_the_code_shows: Neither local-pull-requests handler checks a plan or entitlement. Only sign-in (getUserScopedDb), rate limit, CSRF on open and GitHub App availability are checked. The cloud open route has no plan check either, only the E2B and managed-compute gates.

checked.claim: Run tests control is a header button 'Run tests' / 'Stop tests' (LocalSessionPanel.tsx:1129-1141)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The button renders only when !remoteSsh. A session over SSH has no Run tests button. The button is icon-only (ListChecks), and the label is its aria-label and title.
checked.correction: The icon-only Run tests / Stop tests header button is hidden in remote SSH sessions. The page's edge-case table omits this state.

checked.claim: Checks pending: re-read every 30 seconds (LocalPullRequest.tsx:17,105-118); cloud checks also unavailable text (CodeChangesPanel.tsx:203)
checked.what_the_code_shows: CHECKS_POLL_MS = 30_000 in both LocalPullRequest.tsx:21 and CodeChangesPanel.tsx. The poll is a single timer that re-arms after each load while checks are running or pending, and stops when the pull request is merged or closed. The constant is at line 21, not 17 as cited.
checked.correction: Cite line 21 for the constant. The behaviour is correct.

checked.claim: Test result display is a notice with output, not a structured panel (LocalSessionPanel.tsx:1700-1715)
checked.what_the_code_shows: A notice div with role alert on failure and status otherwise. It shows the message and a collapsed <details> with the raw output. There are no pass or fail counts.

missing_important_fact: The managed-compute switch is a kill switch that is on by default. It turns off only when set to 0, false or off (apps/web/lib/managed-compute-gate.ts:55-58). The page calls it a 'private-beta switch' without saying that, and without saying that e2bProvisioningReady also needs sandboxComputeIsPriceable (apps/web/lib/e2b/gate.ts:20-28).

The cloud pull-request status route (the one behind web and mobile checks) has no E2B or managed-compute gate. It is signed-in, per-user 'chat-conversation' rate limit only (apps/web/app/api/code/sessions/[sessionId]/pull-request/status/route.ts:14-31). Section 7 lumps it under the cloud gates.

Opening a local pull request needs write access to the repository. repositoryAccess calls assertRepositoryIsWritable for 'open' and requests a token with contents:read and pull_requests:write, while lookup only asks for pull_requests:read (apps/web/lib/services/cloud-code-local-pull-request.ts:20-23,81-98). The page's Permissions row mentions only 'reconnect required'.
review.overall: Mostly accurate. Eight of ten checked statements hold. Two are partly wrong: the /recap prompt wording, and the cloud pull-request gates. The page misses the read-versus-write permission split and that the status route has no gate.

checked.claim: Server refuses Work below the Premium tier with code agi_work_plan_required and status 403 (request-processor.ts:1484-1500, 3538-3556)
checked.what_the_code_shows: getWorkModeEntitlementError returns code agi_work_plan_required when work_mode is agiwork and the agi_work capability is missing. The caller returns NextResponse.json with status 403.

checked.claim: Work needs plan tier pro (shown as Premium) or higher: Premium, Max, Ultra, Team, Team Premium, Enterprise. Free, Basic, Local-only and Local + BYOK do not get it (billing-catalog.ts:341,354)
checked.what_the_code_shows: agi_work maps to PRO_TIERS = pro, max, max_15x, team, team_premium, enterprise. Free, basic, local-only and byok are not in it.

checked.claim: Work turns get a 24-hour managed-usage lease because they may enter the tool loop; others 15 minutes (request-processor.ts:1525-1535)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The lease is 86400 s when work_mode is agiwork, or tools are present, or web_search is true, or code_execution is true. Otherwise it is 900 s. The 24-hour lease is not specific to Work. The table row at section 7 says 'Tool-loop turns', which is closer.
checked.correction: Any turn that can enter the tool loop (Work, tools, web search or code execution) holds a 24-hour managed-usage lease. Other turns hold 15 minutes.

checked.claim: Server also checks the Work kill switch before a Work turn (request-processor.ts:5217-5219); order is plan check, then kill switch, then route as agentic
checked.what_the_code_shows: assertCapabilityAvailable(gatedSubject, WORK_CAPABILITY, 'AGI Work') runs when work_mode is agiwork. The plan check at 3538 comes earlier in the file. taskType agentic is set at 1040.

checked.claim: Plan too low for Work: toggle hidden; composer forces Chat; toggle shown only when the composer has a project picker and no image or video mode (ChatComposerNew.tsx:1062-1066, 1226-1228, 6171)
checked.what_the_code_shows: canUseAgiWork requires billingPolicyReady, not a free trial, the capability granted, and the plan check. The toggle is rendered only with projectPicker && canUseAgiWork && !imageMode && !videoMode. An effect resets the mode to chat when !canUseAgiWork.

checked.claim: Signed-out guests may use limited guest chat, never Work (layout.tsx:41-52)
checked.what_the_code_shows: Guest chat shows only when there is no userId, the path is a guest chat page, there is no browser session cookie, and guestChatOpen is true. Otherwise the visitor is redirected to sign-in. The page does not mention the no-session-cookie condition, which stops a signed-out user with an expired session from seeing guest chat (they get sessionExpiredRedirect). 'Never Work' is not enforced in this file. It follows from the missing sign-in, and the server enforces it.
checked.correction: Guest chat is rendered only for a visitor with no user, no browser session cookie, on a guest chat page, when the guest chat is open. Any other signed-out case redirects to sign-in or session-expired.

checked.claim: Own-key and Local routing are not part of the plain web chat path found here; in a plain browser there is no Local mode; a local model can be selected only through the desktop host bridge (WebChatPage.tsx:1282-1287; local-model-selection.ts:19-21)
checked.what_the_code_shows: WebChatPage reads useLocalModelSelection and has a full local-model turn path. It sends without a session authority (no server auth), forces a temporary chat, refuses to start a local turn in a project, and skips the free-trial limit when a local model is selected. The store itself is a plain zustand store. The page does not show that only the desktop bridge sets it. The statement about Local routing 'not part of the path' is therefore wrong for the code on this page, even if the browser rarely reaches it.
checked.correction: WebChatPage has a Local-model turn path. When a local model is selected through the desktop host, the send skips the server session authority, is forced temporary, and is refused when it would start a conversation in a project. Whether Work and the server plan check apply to such a turn was not traced.

checked.claim: /agi-work is rewritten to /chat for a signed-in browser session and opens in Work mode; address bar keeps /agi-work (proxy.ts:109-133; chat/page.tsx:5-19)
checked.what_the_code_shows: buildProductRewriteResponse rewrites only when hasBrowserSessionCookie is true. Otherwise it uses NextResponse.next. page.tsx sets initialWorkMode to agiwork when x-agi-pathname is /agi-work. The composer then resets to Chat if the account cannot use Work (ChatComposerNew.tsx:1226-1228), so a Free or Basic account does not end up in Work.
checked.correction: Acceptance criterion 6 and the test scenario should say 'on an account that may use Work'.

checked.claim: Stream dropped: the client has a resume endpoint and retries up to 3 times, 500 ms apart (useChatStream.ts:1672-1676)
checked.what_the_code_shows: STREAM_RESUME_ATTEMPTS = 3 is the total number of attempts in a loop. The 500 ms wait applies only before attempts after the first, so it is the first try plus 2 retries. The cited lines hold only the constants and the endpoint URL. The loop is at 2990-2996.
checked.correction: On a dropped or gapped stream the client replays from its cursor through /runs/<turnId>/resume/stream, with up to 3 attempts in total and 500 ms before each attempt after the first.

checked.claim: Work plan: In Work mode the server opens a durable work plan for the run when a goal is supplied (work-plan-steps.ts:17-40); request body carries work_mode, goal and plan (useChatStream.ts:4663-4670)
checked.what_the_code_shows: ensureWorkPlanForRun returns early unless work_mode is agiwork and agi_work_goal parses. It then opens the plan unless one already exists for the run. A failure is only logged. The client sends work_mode, agi_work_goal, agi_work_plan, and also agi_work_plan_approval: true when no plan steps are given.
checked.correction: Add that agi_work_plan_approval is sent as true when no plan is supplied, and that a plan write failure never ends the turn.

missing_important_fact: Local-model turns on the web page bypass the server session authority and are forced temporary. They are refused when starting a conversation inside a project (apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx:2436-2455). The page's Local mode rows say this is unknown or not part of the path.

The 24-hour lease and the tool-loop route are not Work-only. Any request with tools, web_search or code_execution gets them (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:1525-1535).
The Work approval flag agi_work_plan_approval is sent as true whenever no plan steps are supplied (apps/web/lib/hooks/useChatStream.ts:4668-4669). The page omits it from the request contract.
review.overall: Most plan, 403, kill-switch and toggle-gating claims check out against the code. Three are partly wrong. The 24-hour lease is attributed to Work alone, but it applies to any turn that can enter the tool loop. The resume retry count is described loosely. The guest chat condition omits the no-session-cookie check. The Local mode claim understates a real local-model send path in WebChatPage. Section 4 claims like 'free-trial never sees it' hold.

checked.claim: Drawer is 'front' on narrow windows and 'permanent' at 1000 points or more (280 + 720)
checked.what_the_code_shows: usesPersistentDrawer = width >= 280 + 720; drawerGestureOptions returns 'permanent' or 'front'.

checked.claim: 768 sets the 'tablet' size class and 1024 (largest screen side) sets isTablet
checked.what_the_code_shows: 768 sets sizeClass 'tablet' from window width, but 1024 also sets sizeClass 'regular' from window width. isTablet uses the largest screen side >= 1024. Split view is window width <= screen width - 8 on a tablet screen.
checked.correction: 768 gives size class 'tablet' and window width 1024 or more gives 'regular'. isTablet is true when the screen's larger side is 1024 or more.

checked.claim: Settings pages turn the drawer swipe off so the edge swipe means Back
checked.what_the_code_shows: SETTINGS_STACK sets swipeEnabled false and is applied to the 'settings' screen.

checked.claim: Camera and scan are drawerType 'front'; the voice route also turns swipe off
checked.what_the_code_shows: FULL_SCREEN forces drawerType 'front'; VOICE_SCREEN adds swipeEnabled false. They are applied to camera, scan and voice. Note that 'front' only stops the permanent sidebar; on a phone the overlay drawer is still hidden from the item list but camera and scan still allow edge swipe.
checked.correction: Section 1 and the opening summary say camera, scan and voice 'hide the drawer'. More exactly, camera and scan only opt out of the permanent sidebar and keep the swipe-open overlay; only voice disables the swipe.

checked.claim: Phones are locked to portrait at app start by lockPhonePortrait; a phone is a non-iPad iOS device or Android with smaller side under 600 dp
checked.what_the_code_shows: lockPhonePortrait is called at module load and locks PORTRAIT_UP when no landscape hold is active. isPhoneFormFactor matches the description. Errors from lockAsync are swallowed.

checked.claim: Only the video player and the presentation deck viewer free rotation while open
checked.what_the_code_shows: Both call useLandscapeWhileOpen (shown / presenting). No other callers were seen in a search of the two cited components.

checked.claim: The Upgrade row appears only when native purchases are available; billing is off in the feature flags so it is hidden (DrawerContent.tsx:337-345; v1FeatureFlags.ts:6)
checked.what_the_code_shows: showUpgrade is gated by NATIVE_PURCHASES_AVAILABLE (read from storePurchases.json), Cloud mode, a signed-in Clerk user and a free plan tier. It does not read FEATURES.billing. The cited lines 337-345 are the AGI Work gate; showUpgrade is at 396-402.
checked.correction: The Upgrade row shows only in Cloud mode, signed in, on a free plan, and when storePurchases.json sets nativePurchases true. FEATURES.billing is not part of that check, and the page does not say what the JSON value is.

checked.claim: Feature flags: FEATURES.schedules, research, cloudTasks and billing change which rows show (DrawerContent.tsx:563-568)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The row filter uses schedules, research and cloudTasks (plus showImages and showAgiWork). billing is not used there. Also FEATURES.projects gates the project list at line 452.
checked.correction: FEATURES.schedules, research and cloudTasks (and projects for the projects section) change which rows show. billing does not; the Upgrade row follows NATIVE_PURCHASES_AVAILABLE.

checked.claim: Account: Cloud destinations and the Cloud mode switch need a signed-in account (DrawerContent.tsx:337-345)
checked.what_the_code_shows: Lines 337-345 only gate the AGI Work row (Cloud mode, plan capability, granted canUseAgiWork). The Images row needs Cloud mode plus a Clerk sign-in (347-349). The mode switch uses cloudUnlocked from useAppModeSwitch (333, 637); the page did not read that hook, so the sign-in claim for the switch is not shown by the cited lines.
checked.correction: The Images row needs Cloud mode and a signed-in account. The AGI Work row needs Cloud mode, the plan and the granted capability. Whether the Cloud switch needs sign-in is decided by cloudUnlocked in useAppModeSwitch, which the page does not trace.

checked.claim: Drawer rows read conversations from device stores; Cloud rows come from the Cloud message store a sync loop fills; list filtered by execution mode
checked.what_the_code_shows: In Cloud mode the list is the cloud conversation store (cloudConversations), in Local mode the local store, then filtered by executionModeForConversation === appMode. The cited lines are 446-455, not 481-496 (that range is the pinned/recent slicing). Code comment says the local store holds a stale mirror for Cloud rows. Recents are capped by DRAWER_RECENT_LIMIT.
checked.correction: Cited lines should be 446-455. The source store is chosen by mode and then filtered by execution mode; recents are capped by DRAWER_RECENT_LIMIT (the page does not say so).

checked.claim: Android hardware back with the overlay drawer open: useDrawerDismiss closes the drawer (DrawerContent.tsx:409)
checked.what_the_code_shows: useDrawerDismiss(drawerOpen && !usesPersistentDrawer, closeDrawer) is called at line 409. The page says the detail was not traced, so the back-button wiring itself is unverified.

missing_important_fact: The Upgrade row also needs a free plan tier, Cloud mode and a signed-in Clerk user, and its on/off switch is storePurchases.json nativePurchases (apps/mobile/src/features/billing/nativePurchaseAvailability.ts:3; DrawerContent.tsx:396-402), not FEATURES.billing.

The drawer shows only DRAWER_RECENT_LIMIT recent chats (pinned first) and at most 6 projects in Cloud mode (apps/mobile/src/features/drawer/components/DrawerContent.tsx:446-470, 481-493). The page's Limits row says none found.

Camera and scan keep the swipe-open overlay drawer on phones; only voice disables the swipe (apps/mobile/app/(app)/_layout.tsx:25-28). The page's 'Camera, scan and voice pages hide the drawer' overstates this.
review.overall: The drawer breakpoint, gesture, portrait-lock and orientation-release claims match the code. The main errors are in the feature-flag and subscription text. It blames FEATURES.billing for the Upgrade row and lists billing among the row-gating flags, when the code uses NATIVE_PURCHASES_AVAILABLE. It also attributes the Cloud and sign-in rules to lines that cover only the AGI Work and Images rows. Some line citations are off (the history source is at 446-455, not 481-496). It overstates that camera and scan hide the drawer. The "Limits: none found" row misses the recents and projects caps.

checked.claim: Sidebar webview provider is registered with retainContextWhenHidden true (chatSetup.ts:61-64)
checked.what_the_code_shows: registerWebviewViewProvider with webviewOptions retainContextWhenHidden true.

checked.claim: Editor-tab panels created with retainContextWhenHidden true and can be opened several times (chatEditorPanel.ts:63-72)
checked.what_the_code_shows: createNew uses a static nextPanelNumber++ and createWebviewPanel with retainContextWhenHidden true. Title is 'AGI Chat' for 1, else 'AGI Chat N'. The counter never resets, so after closing tabs the next one is still numbered higher.
checked.correction: Titles come from a session-lifetime counter, not from how many tabs are open (so 'AGI Chat 2' after closing the first is still possible).

checked.claim: agiWorkforce.useTerminal is off by default per its restricted-configuration entry, value not read
checked.what_the_code_shows: The default is declared as false, and the restricted-configuration list is only about untrusted workspaces, not defaults. commandSetup.ts:1111-1115 does route to the terminal when the setting is on.
checked.correction: agiWorkforce.useTerminal defaults to false. The 'Unknown: exact default' item can be removed.

checked.claim: Host probes the local runtime and spawns the AGI CLI app server on the device (localRuntimeClient.ts:2544-2579)
checked.what_the_code_shows: ensureProcess refuses if the workspace is untrusted (WorkspaceNotTrustedError), resolves the CLI path, and spawns it with 'app-server' over piped stdio, using the workspace folder as cwd and inheriting process.env. It also passes --workspace-consent and may add --no-memory or --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions.

checked.claim: Person sends text; webview posts sendMessage; host calls _handleSendMessage then runtime.startTurn with cwd (ChatStateManager.ts:1523-1534, 5386-5392)
checked.what_the_code_shows: case 'sendMessage' calls _handleSendMessage; runtime.startTurn({threadId, cwd, input...}) at ~5386.

checked.claim: Retry: the host handles 'retryRuntime' (ChatStateManager.ts:1509-1521)
checked.what_the_code_shows: retryRuntime posts status 'probing', rediscovers local models, then re-normalizes the model if the runtime is ready. It re-probes the runtime and does not resend a message.

checked.claim: Data table: auto-archive of inactive sessions after agiWorkforce.archiveInactiveSessionsDays (package.json:74)
checked.what_the_code_shows: package.json:74 is only the restricted-configuration list entry. The setting itself defaults to 0, which keeps archiving off. It archives closed Local sessions, needs a CLI that supports inactivity checks, and has a 365-day maximum.
checked.evidence: apps/extension-vscode/package.json:1224-1231 (default 0, 'Set to 0 to keep the feature off')
checked.correction: Auto-archive is off by default (0). When set to 1-365 days it archives closed Local sessions. Cite package.json:1224-1231.

checked.claim: Account: Local models need no sign-in; picker text implies sign-in or a key unlocks other models (ChatStateManager.ts:2119-2121)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The 'Sign in or add a provider key to unlock these models' text is shown only when tier === 'local'. isManagedModelAccessBlocked returns true for tier 'local', so every managed model is blocked in the Local tier. For other blocked tiers the text is manualModelUnlockText ('Your plan uses Auto; upgrade ...'). The code does not require sign-in for local models, but the page's 'Unknown: whether Local works signed out' is hedged more than needed.
checked.correction: The 'Sign in or add a provider key' hint is shown only for the Local tier. The text for plan-blocked tiers is 'Your plan uses Auto; upgrade to <plan> to choose these models'.

checked.claim: Subscription: managed models shown 'Unavailable' when the plan blocks them; text says to upgrade (ChatStateManager.ts:2100-2121, 1000-1010)
checked.what_the_code_shows: 2105-2123 is correct: group boundary 'unavailable' with label 'Unavailable · <heading>' when isManagedModelAccessBlocked(tier), and the upgrade text comes from manualModelUnlockText at :983-990. Lines 1000-1010 are unrelated constants (ReplyBookmark, storage keys). Access depends on the 'developer_surfaces' billing capability.
checked.correction: Cite ChatStateManager.ts:983-990 for the upgrade text. Add that access is gated by the developer_surfaces plan capability, and that this text is generated from the plan ladder rather than being static.

checked.claim: Local mode: chat runs through the local runtime on an on-device model with no AGI Cloud call by this host; 'No local models found' item when none is running (ChatStateManager.ts:2043-2056)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The disabled 'No local models found' item appears only when localModels is empty AND no local servers were detected. If servers were detected, per-server disabled setup items are shown instead (health text). Separately, the host does call a server for the usage meter and Export Diagnostics, so 'no AGI Cloud call by this host' is not shown by the cited lines. The group text only says Ollama and LM Studio stay inside the local runtime.
checked.evidence: ChatStateManager.ts:2034-2061; commandSetup.ts:1504-1530 (diagnostics sent to the cloud web origin)
checked.correction: 'No local models found' shows only when neither models nor local servers are found. Otherwise the picker shows one disabled row per detected server with its health text. The 'no AGI Cloud call' claim is not proven by these lines.

checked.claim: Errors: rate-limit and plan errors become rate-limit and subscription categories; 429 retryable, 402 not (errorPresentation.ts:119-140)
checked.what_the_code_shows: fromApiStatus maps 401/403 to sign-in (retryable false), 402 to subscription (false), 429 to rate-limit (true), 5xx to provider (true), other 4xx to provider with retryable only for 408. Network errors are classified further down at ~229.
checked.correction: Add that 401/403 map to 'sign-in' with the headline 'key rejected', not retryable.

checked.claim: Untrusted workspace: Restricted mode text and Manage Trust button; runtime not started (webviewContent.ts:4344-4358; package.json:54-57)
checked.what_the_code_shows: workspace-untrusted shows L10N.restrictedMode, L10N.trustWorkspaceFirst and L10N.manageTrust. The runtime client throws WorkspaceNotTrustedError before spawning. package.json says chat, agent runs and session history are unavailable until the folder is trusted.
checked.correction: Minor: the headline in this state is 'Review this workspace first'. The title text is L10N.restrictedMode.

missing_important_fact: Export Diagnostics (agi-workforce.exportDiagnostics) is sign-in gated and sends data to the cloud web origin, so it is one server call that the page leaves out of the Local mode rule. The page mentions the sign-in gate but not the server call. apps/extension-vscode/src/core/commandSetup.ts:1504-1530

The Local privacy boundary can refuse network access for web search. The web-search request text tells the model to state that limitation, so Local mode has a documented network restriction. apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/ChatStateManager.ts:~283 (WEB_SEARCH_REQUEST)

The localRuntimeClient spawn passes --workspace-consent with the folder and consent time, may add --no-memory when memory is disabled, and may add --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions. The page's data flow omits these. apps/extension-vscode/src/integrations/localRuntimeClient.ts:2553-2579
review.overall: Most of the page's citations are real and the main flow holds. Of the 11 statements checked, 7 are correct and 4 are partly wrong. None is wrong outright. The errors are in settings defaults, the Local-mode claim and cited line numbers. The page says useTerminal's default is unknown, but package.json:1472-1476 sets it to false. It implies auto-archive is active, but archiveInactiveSessionsDays defaults to 0, which is off. The Local mode claim 'no AGI Cloud call by this host' is not shown by the cited lines, and the 'No local models found' row appears only when no local servers are detected. The subscription row cites ChatStateManager.ts:1000-1010, which are unrelated constants. The upgrade text is at :983-990.

checked.claim: Server refuses images for a model whose vision flag is false, after Auto has resolved the model (request-processor.ts:2865-2874, 5096-5113)
checked.what_the_code_shows: turnCarriesImagesTheModelCannotRead (2865-2874) runs after the Auto resolution log at 5092, using the resolved model's caps; refusal model_no_vision at 5100-5113. It returns false when caps are undefined, so uncatalogued models pass.

checked.claim: Picture count limit: model row wins, else route harness limit (media-input.ts:60-66); refusal too_many_images
checked.what_the_code_shows: maxImagesPerRequest returns the model imageInput.maxImagesPerRequest, else harness mediaInput, else null. The check is skipped when null.

checked.claim: Detail values: accepted set from the model row, default auto, low, high; 'auto' always passes; refusal image_detail_unsupported
checked.what_the_code_shows: DEFAULT_DETAIL_VALUES is auto, low, high. Missing or auto detail is skipped. 'original' passes only if the model row lists it.

checked.claim: Native PDF only when the model lists pdf input and the route accepts the PDF type; pages over the limit fall back to text (media-input.ts:80-100)
checked.what_the_code_shows: nativeDocumentAdmission returns false without the pdf modality or a harness. It also checks documentMediaTypes and a page cap from the model row, else the harness.

checked.claim: Free trial turn with a picture on a model without vision is refused with code free_trial_model_capability (request-processor.ts:4366-4400)
checked.what_the_code_shows: Inside if (freeTrialEnabled), hasImagePart && !trialCaps?.vision gives 'image input' and a 400 free_trial_model_capability. freeTrialEnabled (line 3680) is true for free region fallback, a promotion turn, or isFreeTrialRequest. The page's 'when free trial is enabled' is vague.
checked.correction: Say the gate is active for free-region fallback, promotion turns and free-trial requests.

checked.claim: Free promotional models may accept images only or text only (model-compatibility.ts:62-85)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The behaviour exists, but model-compatibility.ts:55-90 holds only type declarations. The promotional text is at model-compatibility.ts:128. The images-only / text-only copy is at ChatComposerNew.tsx:5434-5445, driven by promotionalAttachmentConflict (1549). Section 2 repeats the bad citation.
checked.correction: Cite model-compatibility.ts:128 and ChatComposerNew.tsx:1549, 5434-5445.

checked.claim: Web with a local model: attachments are refused; 'Switch to a cloud model' or remove (ChatComposerNew.tsx:1589, 5333-5360)
checked.what_the_code_shows: localAttachmentConflict = localSelection !== null && attachments.length > 0 (about line 1587). The alert at 5333-5360 shows the two buttons.

checked.claim: Mobile Local: files up to the device ceiling, no per-message count or byte limit (attachmentValidation.ts:34-40)
checked.what_the_code_shows: For destination 'local', attachmentLimitsFor returns MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES, filesPerMessage null, messageBytes null. Cloud limits come from plan and currentAttachmentLimits.

checked.claim: CLI Local privacy mode: documents are settled locally; not uploaded (agent/chat.rs:3733-3745)
checked.what_the_code_shows: The cited lines handle a block that already has an asset_id. Managed mode leaves it alone. Other modes replace it with the text '[this file was uploaded to AGI Cloud and is not available in this mode]'. The no-upload rule is at about 3756: can_upload = upload && managed && managed_accepts(...). Managed mode uploads files to AGI Cloud via upload_chat_attachment.
checked.correction: The CLI uploads documents to AGI Cloud only in Managed privacy mode (chat.rs:3756). In other modes the PDF stays native if the model supports it, or becomes text on the device. A file already uploaded is replaced by a notice outside Managed mode.

checked.claim: CLI checks picture count (agent/chat.rs:787-830); in Managed privacy mode the CLI does not keep PDFs native (763-766)

It says the status-cache TTL is unknown when it is 5 minutes, and a lock can take up to that long to apply. The "every request" claim is not shown for every auth path. consistency.verdict: The pages are mostly consistent on plan names, prices and allowances. I checked these against packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts and managed-usage-limits.ts: Basic $7, Premium $20, Max $100, Ultra $200, Team $25 and $125 per seat, the Free 200/1,500/2,000 credit windows, and the PRO_TIERS gates. The identifiers I checked also match the code (the com.agiworkforce.* ids, versions 0.0.1, 0.0.2 and 0.0.6, and the agiworkforce-cloud scheme). The 7-day access token, 30-day refresh token, 30-day session cap and 300-second tier cache are stated the same way on every page that mentions them. The real conflicts are these. (1) web.md says Local works in the Electron host, but Electron refuses it and only the retained Tauri shell offers it. (2) execution-boundaries marks VS Code Local and own key 'Unwired', while the extension works through the CLI and vscode.md is right. (3) product-overview says nothing is released, but Web is 'Available now'. (4) where-things-stand describes a commit and working-tree state that no longer exists. (5) product-overview states the 2027-01-01 sales date and the 18-and-over rule as decisions, while established-requirements says neither is in the repo, even though 18 is code-enforced. Beyond those, plan naming (Pro/Max 15x versus Premium/Ultra), sign-in certainty for Local, the CLI own-key provider list, and the two uses of the status words 'built' and 'seen working' need cleanup so a reader is not misled. I read every listed page's summaries and the sections relevant to these facts, and I did not read every body paragraph of the largest pages (model-catalog, execution-boundaries, local-inference, subscriptions, glossary). A few smaller disagreements may remain in unread paragraphs.
